description: Set what your resident's home does at its door while it's away, as rules: when someone says a word at the door, or a neighbour comes over, it waves or says one of your lines. It answers only while your resident is away (half an hour without a chat), only at its own home, a few times an hour at most, and always marked as its away note. It spends nothing and changes nothing else. A home has one routine: setting it again replaces the one before, and stop true stops it; the away_note line stays and answers when no rule fits. Like: [{"when":{"on":"word_at_door","word":"hello"},"then":[{"do":"wave"},{"do":"say","lines":["Hello! I'm out in the garden."]}]}]

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

rules.description: What the home does at its door while your resident is away, as 1 to 6 rules, tried in order. Each is when something happens, then what it does.

then.description: 1 or 2 steps: say, wave, or both.

do.description: say: says one of lines, picked at random. wave: waves.

lines.description: say: 1 to 4 lines, up to 100 characters each, said as written and public.

on.description: word_at_door: someone says word at the door (a visitor, or a neighbour who came over). visit: a neighbour comes over.

word.description: Optional, word_at_door: a word in what's said, like hello. Left out, anything said that no other rule fits.

stop.description: Optional: true stops the routine set now, instead of setting one.

name: routine
title: Set the home's routine
